Welcome, visitor. [ / Log in ] Sadoff Investment Management Boosted Apple (AAPL) Position by $1.88 Million as Shares Rose; Wcm Investment Management Has Lifted Hdfc Bank LTD (HDB) Position 
March 12, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia 
Wcm Investment Management increased its stake in Hdfc Bank Ltd (HDB) by 2.64% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wcm Investment Management bought 193,290 shares as the company’s stock rose 20.33% with the market. The institutional investor held 7.51M shares of the commercial banks company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $723.53 million, up from 7.31 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wcm Investment Management who had been investing in Hdfc Bank Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $74.68B market cap company. The stock increased 1.00% or $0.96   $97.35. About 178,859 shares traded. HDFC Bank Limited (NYSE:HDB) has risen 36.23%   outperformed by 19.53% the S&P500. 
Sadoff Investment Management Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 167.58% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sadoff Investment Management Llc bought 12,193 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 19,469 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $3.00 million, up from 7,276 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sadoff Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $922.51 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.02% or $1.83   $181.81. About 18.30 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48%   outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500. 
Wcm Investment Management, which manages about $7.92 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Grupo Aeroportuario Del Sure (NYSE:ASR) by 9,668 shares to 14,390 shares, valued at $2.75M in 2017Q3, according to the filing. 
Among 3 analysts covering HDFC Bank Limited ( NYSE:HDB ), 1 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 2 Hold. Therefore 33% are positive. HDFC Bank Limited had 5 analyst reports since August 27, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The company was downgraded on Wednesday, September 2 by Zacks. The firm has “Equal-Weight” rating by Morgan Stanley given on Tuesday, March 21. On Thursday, August 27 the stock rating was downgraded by Zacks to “Hold”. The rating was upgraded by Zacks to “Hold” on Monday, September 21. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Wednesday, September 14 by Goldman Sachs. 
Among 53 analysts covering Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ), 34 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 18 Hold. Therefore 64% are positive. Apple Inc. had 383 analyst reports since July 21, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was maintained by Drexel Hamilton on Friday, June 9 with “Buy”. Brean Capital maintained Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) rating on Wednesday, April 27. Brean Capital has “Buy” rating and $125 target. The stock has “Buy” rating by Brean Capital on Wednesday, July 27. The company was maintained on Friday, September 16 by Canaccord Genuity. The company was maintained on Monday, December 14 by Barclays Capital. The stock has “Buy” rating by UBS on Friday, September 11. As per Wednesday, July 27, the company rating was maintained by Drexel Hamilton. Canaccord Genuity maintained the shares of AAPL in report on Monday, November 20 with “Buy” rating. The firm has “Overweight” rating by Pacific Crest given on Monday, March 7. As per Wednesday, December 23, the company rating was maintained by Stifel Nicolaus.   Winifred Garcia
